correctness.rationale: For N=J_(n−2)⊕J_2, n≥5, over arbitrary fields the nilpotent fixed-centralizer matrices have module-coefficient form with a0=d0=0. Coordinate reduction extracts x,b,c,B,C∈k^m subject to rank([x;b;c])≤1 and b∧C+B∧c=0, with (n−3)m free affine factors. The closed L={b=c=0} has dimension 3m; the complementary U has common line ℓ∈P^(m−1), parameters ν,λ,μ with (λ,μ)≠0 and m−1 independent constraints on (B,C), hence irreducible dimension 2m+3. Rank(x,B,C)≤2 on closure(U) but L contains rank 3 for m≥3, proving exactly 2 components with dimensions nm,(n−1)m+3. Explicit degenerations yield L⊂closure(U) for m≤2, hence irreducible (m0 trivial). Over F_q, b=c=0 contributes q^(3m), and nonzero proportional b,c contribute (q+1)(q^m−1)·q·q^(m+1), yielding q^(nm)+q²(q+1)(q^((n−1)m)−q^((n−2)m)) after free factors; m0 gives one empty tuple. Independent complete enumeration of five-coordinate two-vector constraints gave q2:208 and q3:3321, matching source; inspected actual matrix-multiplication checker code, which supplements algebraic proof.
